glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_imp.desc: Pact: calls a winged imp for 60s. It hovers by your side and spits fireballs at your foes (up to 3).
glyph.isekai_mahou.shadow_weapon.desc: Pact: conjures a Shadow Blade in your hand for 45s. Withers targets and steals life; vanishes if dropped.
glyph.isekai_mahou.death_contract.desc: Pact: marks the target for 15s. If it dies marked, you recover health and mana.
glyph.isekai_mahou.demon_wings.desc: Pact: demon wings for 20s. You can fly; when they fade you glide down with Slow Falling.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_demon.desc: Legendary pact: opens a hellish portal and brings a Greater Demon for 45s. Fire claws, area stomp and volleys.
glyph.isekai_mahou.raise_dead.desc: Necromancy: raises an undead servant from the ground for 60s. Servant limit: 2 + what the Ossuary Rite unlocked.
glyph.isekai_mahou.bone_shield.desc: Necromancy: bone shards grant absorption for 30s and return 35% of melee damage to the attacker.
glyph.isekai_mahou.soul_drain.desc: Necromancy: damage that heals you for half the amount dealt. On a kill, the soul grants extra XP.
glyph.isekai_mahou.corpse_explosion.desc: Necromancy: detonates one of your temporary servants or a nearby undead, dealing area damage (no block damage).
glyph.isekai_mahou.bone_army.desc: Necromancy: raises 3 Bone Warriors with sword and shield for 40s (up to 6).
glyph.isekai_mahou.lich_form.desc: Legendary necromancy: become a lich for 30s. Slow flight, armor, 25% less damage, life-draining attacks; undead ignore you.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.shadow_blade.lore: Conjured by the Pact. Vanishes if dropped or stored.
message.isekai_mahou.origins_b.blade_van: The Shadow Blade dissolves into smoke.
message.isekai_mahou.origins_b.blade_no_: No inventory room for the Shadow Blade.
message.isekai_mahou.origins_b.servant_c: Servant limit reached (%s). Your permanent servants cannot be undone.
message.isekai_mahou.origins_b.lich_rise: You rise as a Lich! Double-jump to float.
